tasks.title: Stop 1
tasks.statement:
Practical Geo Field evaluation – Site B (Katsurabata)
Field kit: Hand lens
Time limit: 8 min.
Explore the rock exposed at this site. Read the following questions (B1 and B 2), and circle one letter that corresponds to the correct answer.

parts.question:
B 1. What is the most appropriate rock type at this site?
    a) Sedimentary rock
    b) Volcanic rock
    c) Plutonic rock
    d) Metamorphic rock

B 2.What is the most appropriate name of the rock at this site?
         g) Basalt                                       a) Limestone
         h) Chert                                        b) Tuff
         i)   Mudstone                                   c) Obsidian
         j)   Gabbro                                     d) Sandstone
         k) Gneiss                                       e) Schist
         l)   Granite                                    f) Rhyolite

tasks.statement:
Field kit: Clinometer
Time limit: 8 min.

parts.question:
B 3. What is the name of the dominant plane at this site?
    a) Bedding plane
b) Joint plane
c) Unconformity plane
     d) Cleavage plane
B 4. Measure the dip and strike of the rock surface marked, and circle one letter that corresponds to the most appropriate symbol of the dip and strike.
